info.name: MODO Sales Executive Mobile API v1
info.description: ERP APIs for the mobile prototype. Set an ERP base_url, not the Sites preview URL. Run delete actions individually. Approval and rejection are alternative actions, and require a different reviewer. Author: ragul-onemodo.

request.description: Email/password login returns the bearer token directly. Alternative: Send WhatsApp OTP and Verify OTP.

exec: const d=pm.response.json().data; if(d.token) pm.environment.set('api_token',d.token); if(d.challenge_id) { pm.environment.set('challenge_id',d.challenge_id); pm.environment.unset('api_token'); pm.environment.unset('otp'); }

request.description: Passwordless alternative. Set mobile to a uniquely registered user number. Returns 202 after WhatsApp provider submission. Enter the received code in otp and run Verify OTP.

exec: const d=pm.response.json().data; if(d.token) pm.environment.set('api_token',d.token); if(d.challenge_id) { pm.environment.set('challenge_id',d.challenge_id); pm.environment.unset('api_token'); pm.environment.unset('otp'); }
